notes: RETIRED — DO NOT REGENERATE. Identity-accent props are authored in CODE (art/workbench/accents/build.mjs), not generated. PIPELINE LIMIT LEARNED HERE: PixelLab is excellent at whole characters (it produced all 24 accepted player bodies) but cannot produce a small standalone PART of a character. Asked for a 32px 'crest ornament' with 'helmet, head, face' in the negatives, all six candidates came back as complete horned helmets — asking for a part of a thing summons the whole thing, the same failure class as the Conduit's mask. At 12-20px a crest is a few dozen pixels, which is precisely the scale where hand-placed pixels beat any generator. The rest of the accent system is real and stays: baked head anchors (art/workbench/accents/anchors.mjs -> shared/src/sprites/headAnchors.ts, ~3px spread across all 25 bodies), client seating in client/src/fx/identityAccent.ts, and the PLAYER_ACCENTS registry. Kept as a record of the limit; delete the file if it ever becomes confusing.
